body: Final release audit reproduced two simultaneous browser downloads of the same EPUB: one returned an error after Calibre rejected overlapping exports. Successful exports also renamed unique artifacts onto a shared client basename. Fixed in cb25b58f73 using the existing process-shared Calibre lock, failure fallback, and unique staging names. Four new tests seen red then green, actual desktop/mobile concurrent shared reading/download now passes.

resolution.note: Four behavioral cases seen red; lock coordination, export fallback, and unique staged artifact tests pass. Real desktop/mobile downloads of the same shared EPUB succeed concurrently, with actual reader page turns and role-denial controls.

title: Concurrent downloads collide during metadata export and shared staging cleanup
